deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing gesture ('Histologically, this is the endocervical canal here, and so you're looking at the cervix here') into an unsourced spatial description ('and the cervix is seen alongside it'). The text does not state that the cervix is seen alongside the canal, and anatomically the cervix is the neck of the womb through which the canal passes, making this description misleading.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Histologically, this is the endocervical canal here, and so you're looking at the cervix here.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Histologically, the endocervical canal runs through the neck of the womb, and the cervix is seen alongside it.

considerations.sourcePassage: You can see maybe with sharp eyes, you'll see that there's a mitotic cell here and there's one here
considerations.reason: This is the lecturer pointing out specific examples on the slide image to illustrate the general point that mitotic cells occur at the basement layer, which is preserved in the rewrite.

considerations.reason: This is a remark about course logistics and future practical sessions, which is permitted to be omitted or retained.
